research.facts:
USA WNT — WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Oklahoma
**Sources:** wbsc.org, usasoftball.com
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Event: WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Oklahoma, Devon Park, Oklahoma City, Sept 12–16, 2026
- Six-team field: USA (No. 2), Netherlands (No. 6), Mexico (No. 7), China (No. 8), New Zealand (No. 23), Brazil
- USA opens vs Mexico at 7:30 PM on Sept 12 (final game of opening day; Opening Ceremony at 6:30 PM)
- Sept 12 schedule: Brazil vs China at 1:00 PM, New Zealand vs Netherlands at 4:00 PM, Mexico vs USA at 7:30 PM
- Format: round-robin, then Sept 16 play-off bracket
- Sept 16 play-offs: 5th vs 6th at 10:00 AM; 1st vs 2nd at 1:00 PM (winner → Finals 2027 direct); 3rd vs 4th at 4:00 PM; Repechage at 7:00 PM (for 2nd Finals spot)
- Top 2 teams advance to 2027 Finals in Redcliffe, QLD, Australia (April 5–11, 2027)
- LA28 Olympic Games qualifier
- USA roster: Patty Gasso (HC), JT Gasso, Jennifer Rocha (coaching staff)
- Rachel Garcia and Dejah Mulipola: 2020 U.S. Olympic Team veterans
- Seven athletes from 2025 World Games gold medal squad; 10 players from 2025 Down Under Series
- USA went 5-0 at 2026 International Cup at same Devon Park venue
- OU players on Team USA: Alyssa Brito, Jayda Coleman, Tiare Jennings, Kelly Maxwell (current Sooners); also Kendall Wells and Rachel Garcia on roster
**Countdown:** 4 days to Sept 12 opener

research.facts:
Class of 2028 — In-Person Contact Window Opens TOMORROW
**Sources:** extrainningsoftball.com, linedrivemedia.com, on3.com, nextcommit.ai
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Sept 9 at 7:00 AM ET = in-person contact window opens for Class of 2028
- Tied to Labor Day calendar, not a fixed date — moves each year
- Before Sept 9: D1 coaches may call, text, video chat, DM on social (since Sept 1)
- Starting Sept 9: in-person off-campus contact, on-campus visits, in-person evaluation at competitions all permitted
- Peyton Ushery already committed to Georgia (No. 2, Line Drive Media HOT 100) on Sept 1
- Record 1,226 Extra Innings Softball nominations for Class of 2028
- Class of 2028 = rising juniors (fall 2026)
- The first 60-90 minutes of the window (7–8:30 AM ET) typically see the most rapid commit activity
**Countdown:** TOMORROW — Sept 9, 7 AM ET
